reason: A skill-management plugin that lists filesystem skills and toggles their model visibility by renaming SKILL.md files, with both agent tools and a Settings UI.

summaries.zh: 用于列出文件系统中的技能，并通过代理工具或设置页面启用和禁用技能。
summaries.en: Lists filesystem skills and lets users enable or disable them through agent tools or a Settings page.

capabilities: Lists skills from four configured filesystem roots
Enables or disables skills by renaming SKILL.md files
Provides agent tools and a Settings page for skill management
Runs a local Node.js bridge through the host subprocess service
